prompt: Phát biểu nào mô tả đúng nhất Webhooks, Reverse Proxy, CORS & Browser-vs-curl?
options: CORS is browser response-sharing policy; curl does not enforce it, and Backend authorization remains separate.
Chỉ cần process tồn tại là toàn bộ use case đã PASS
Có thể bỏ qua evidence nếu lệnh không báo lỗi
SV1 phải giành implementation ownership từ SV2/SV3
answer: CORS is browser response-sharing policy; curl does not enforce it, and Backend authorization remains separate.
explanation: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing controls whether browser JavaScript may read a cross-origin response through response headers and preflight behavior. Reverse proxies route external paths to internal upstreams. Curl bypasses browser CORS enforcement, so curl success can help isolate—not disprove—a browser-origin issue.
